acceptance: A green main closes the stop and the landings resume
fix: Poll the required CI of origin/main from the loop tick at a policy interval (reuse mainCIRedForSHA). On red: emit GATE_REPO_MAIN_CI_RED (INCIDENT) with the failed job names, and open the main-red stop without a lane reproduction. On green: close it. A ship precheck refuses a landing while the stop is open, with a typed cause.
summary: 2026-11-20: main required CI went red at 02:11Z after cycle 2554; zero signals until the boundary, and three more landings (2555, 2550, 2549) went onto the red main. GATE_REPO_MAIN_RED_STOP opens only when a lane reproduces a red test itself (go/internal/core/main_red_stop_open.go:90). The only CI poll (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_loop_wavesync.go:33 mainCIRedForSHA) runs at the next wave start.
title: a red main CI is invisible during a wave, so lanes keep landing on a red main
